brief:
A Palestinian man, Muhammad Shumali, died today from severe injuries sustained in an earlier Israeli strike on the al-Daraj neighborhood east of Gaza City, Shehab Wire reported. The strike had targeted a group of civilians in the area.

Medical personnel treated Shumali for critical wounds following the initial bombardment, but he succumbed to his injuries today. The al-Daraj district, located in the eastern part of Gaza City, has faced repeated strikes during the ongoing military operations in the territory.
